description.from:
Outcome: Define the SiteConfig document a tenant can set, as a JSON schema derived from the validated projection.json settings (src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/config.py; unknown keys are already errors). v1 surface (owner decision 7): site name, tagline, purpose line, sections (name, description, slug), nav order, home template id, footer links, analytics id, consent region policy, feature blocks on or off (findings, videos, conversations, concepts, reader votes). Not settable in v1 on the shared tier: hooks, arbitrary CSS, sizes, spacing, image ratio, borders, urls.style, urls.basePath, pattern redirects, the image pipeline, cache settings, plugins (those are entitlements), citations.links (fixed default). A dedicated site's projection.json is a superset and is converted with one function, so both tiers run one schema.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): src/papyrus_content/projection/standard/config.py, new src/papyrus_content/site_config/ (schema JSON + converter), lib/site-config.ts (TypeScript validator for the newsroom), docs/building-a-papyrus-static-site.md.

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: features_backend/site-config-schema.feature):
Scenario: A setting outside the v1 surface is refused for a shared tenant
    Given a shared tenant's SiteConfig with a custom CSS file
    When it is validated
    Then it is refused naming the setting

Scenario: TI's projection.json converts to a valid SiteConfig
    Given Threat Intelligence's web/projection.json
    When it is converted
    Then the result validates and renders the same pages

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-c020ce. Blocks PPY-3aa10f, PPY-413576, PPY-b21340, PPY-272c84, PPY-d0a3d5. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-f0ae90.

Testing: pytest and TS tests share one vector file; golden renders of TI and MoM via the converter.
Rollout: Releasable alone (schema and converter).
Risk and mitigation: Risk: knob sprawl. Mitigation: a setting enters the schema only when a second site needs it (memo rule), each with a Gherkin scenario.

Releasable on its own: yes.
DynamoDB index: none.
AppSync authorisation: unchanged.
Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR on branch docs/multi-tenant-architecture).
